prompt: Some countries are considering reducing the standard working week from five days to four, with no reduction in pay. Do the advantages of this change outweigh the disadvantages?
essay:
In some countries, the government is thinking to reduce the working week from five days to four days, and the workers will get the same salary. There are some advantages and disadvantages of this idea. In this essay I will explain both of them.

The main advantage of the four days week is that the workers will have more free time. They can spend the time with their family, do the exercise or learn a new hobby, so they will be more happy and more healthy. Another advantage is that the stress will be reduced. Nowadays many people suffer from the stress because of the long working hours, and this cause many health problems. If they work only four days, this problem will become less. Moreover, there will be less traffic on the roads because people travel one day less, which is also good for the environment.

On the other hand, there are also disadvantages. The main disadvantage is for the companies, because they have to pay the same salary but the employees work less. This will increase the cost and some small companies can not survive. Another disadvantage is that some services must work every day, for example the hospitals and the police, so they will need to employ the more staff. Also some workers will do the same amount of the work in four days, so they will be more stressed than before.

In conclusion, the four days week has the advantages for the workers and the disadvantages for the companies. Both of them should be considered carefully by the government before making this big decision.
title: A four-day standard working week
